(ii) 'The seven participating countries decided to maintain September 2026 required production for October 2026 as detailed in the table below.' (iii) 'The seven countries reiterated their collective commitment to achieve full conformity with the Declaration of Cooperation.' (iv) 'The seven OPEC+ countries will continue to hold monthly meetings to review market conditions. The next meeting will be held on 4 October 2026.' Headline: 'Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria, and Oman reaffirm commitment to market stability'. === VERDICT: OUTCOME (3) DEFERRED AGAIN / NO Q4 DECISION. The statement decides OCTOBER ONLY -- one of Q4's three months -- and contains NO sentence about November, December, Q4 as a block, the ~2 mb/d 2022-era cuts, or 2027 baselines. The Q4 path is handed to the 4 Oct 2026 monthly meeting. Per the letter, (3) IS A REAL ANSWER, not a null. === SUB-FINDING, strictly additive and NOT a re-grade: OUTCOME (2) IS REFUTED FOR OCTOBER. That 188 kb/d monthly increment was NOT repeated for October. Increments did not continue into the first Q4 month. === ⛔ DO NOT UPGRADE THIS TO OUTCOME (1). The letter says in terms: DO NOT READ A DEFERRAL AS A PAUSE. A one-month hold with the next decision 28 days away is not an ADOPTED Q4 PAUSE; the statement never uses the word pause and never scopes beyond October. Grading (1) here would be the exact substitution the row was frozen nine days early to prevent. === DELIVERABILITY GATE (LESSONS #10), applied as the letter requires and it BINDS THE READ: effective OPEC spare ~0.02 mb/d = ~20 kb/d [EIA STEO COPS_OPEC 2026Q3/Q4 = 0.020, graded at the primary 8/13; SINGLE-AGENCY -- neither the Aug MOMR nor the Aug IEA OMR published a spare figure]. The 188 kb/d September adjustment is ~9x that spare, so it was ~90% PAPER; NOT repeating it for October therefore removes almost nothing PHYSICAL. ⇒ THE OCTOBER HOLD IS A NEAR-ZERO PHYSICAL EVENT IN BOTH DIRECTIONS -- costless supply-side signalling. A grade that reads it as real Q4 supply support is the LESSONS #10 error with the sign flipped. === WHAT MOVES: NOTHING REGISTERED. THESIS Phase-2 flush timing UNMOVED (the sequencing claim is neither weakened nor confirmed -- an undecided Q4 is the same information state the row started in, now with one month of it resolved and near-zero physical content). It was not, and could not have been. Same class as this row's own 8/21 calendar correction (the 2027-quota leg is a NOVEMBER meeting). ⇒ A FUTURE ROW MUST NOT BE WRITTEN AS 'the meeting where Q4/Q1 is decided'; the only quarterly-scope decision point is the ONOMM/capacity-approval meeting. === ⚑ AND THE UN-REFRESHED RELAY WAS DIRECTIONALLY RIGHT, WHICH IS NOT A REASON TO TRUST IT: field 7(b) flagged the Bloomberg 2026-07-28 delegate sourcing ('OPEC+ Plans to Pause Quota Hikes After September') as SINGLE-SOURCED, self-caveated and un-refreshed since before the 8/17 MoU expiry and Brent's run to $94. Being right on direction off a stale single source is the 8/2 error succeeding by luck; the letter's discipline is what produced the correct SCOPE. === SEVEN, NOT EIGHT, IS NOT A CHANGE: both the 8/2 and 9/6 statements name the same seven (UAE is not in this April+November-2023 voluntary-adjustment cohort as OPEC frames it). Checked precisely so it is not written up as a defection. === NOT VERIFIED AT THE PRIMARY (declared): the per-country 'table below' does not render in the page's static HTML (no <table> element, no linked PDF/image found) ⇒ the per-country October required-production numbers are UNKNOWN-AT-PRIMARY.
